rounds.ai_message: Good morning. This is Wang Lei from Sunrise Dye House. You sent us some Pantone numbers yesterday. How can I help you?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 早上好,我是 Sunrise 染厂的王磊。你昨天发了几个潘通色号,请问有什么可以帮您?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 自我介绍,说明来意:需要对色样,准备大货
rounds.common_mistakes: dye 是动词(染色),dye house 是染厂。dyeing 是名词/动名词(染色工艺)。
rounds.tips_zh: 联系染厂时要先报:面料类型(梭织/针织)、颜色(潘通号)、克重、数量。
rounds.user_response_example: Good morning, Wang. This is Chen Wei from Lily Garments. I need to dye some cotton single jersey for our summer T-shirt line.

rounds.ai_message: Cotton single jersey, OK. How many Pantone colors, and can you tell me the GSM of the fabric?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 棉单面汗布,好的。有几个潘通色?面料克重是多少?
rounds.common_mistakes: single jersey(单面汗布) 不要说成 single cloth,single jersey 是针织标准名。
rounds.tips_zh: 对色时讲克重有助于染厂算染料用量和工艺时间。
rounds.user_response_example: We have 4 colors. The fabric is 180 GSM, 26s single yarn, 100% combed cotton.

rounds.ai_message: 180 GSM combed cotton, that's standard. We will use reactive dye. For the lab dip, we need 5-7 days. Do you have the Pantone TPX or TCX numbers?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 180 克精梳棉,常规的。我们用活性染料。对色样需要 5-7 天。你们有潘通 TPX 还是 TCX 号?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 提供潘通号,确认色卡系统
rounds.common_mistakes: reactive dye(活性染料) 是棉最常用,色牢度好;disperse dye(分散染料) 用于涤纶。
rounds.tips_zh: 棉用活性染料,涤纶用分散染料,腈纶用阳离子染料,不要混。
rounds.user_response_example: TCX numbers, I'll email them to you this morning. The main color is 19-4052 navy blue.

rounds.ai_message: Good. Once we receive the Pantone, we start the lab dip. About the lab dip timing — if you want rush, we can do 4 days with a small surcharge. Normal is 6 days. Which do you prefer?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。收到潘通号后启动打色样。打色样时间 — 加急 4 天,加一点费用;常规 6 天。你选哪个?
rounds.common_mistakes: surcharge 是'附加费',口语里直接说 surcharge 即可。
rounds.tips_zh: 加急一般每色 30-50 美元,小批量色样常用。
rounds.user_response_example: Normal is OK for us. 6 days works, no rush needed. Just send the lab dips by DHL.

rounds.ai_message: Sure. DHL is fine, freight collect on your account. About the bulk — our MOQ is 300 kg per color. How much do you need?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 可以。DHL 寄,运费到付用你们账号。大货方面,我们起染量是每个色 300 公斤。你们要多少?
rounds.common_mistakes: freight collect 是'运费到付',口语里说 freight collect on your account 即可。
rounds.tips_zh: 起染量(MOQ)是染缸最低经济量,过小染厂会加价或拒绝。
rounds.user_response_example: Each color is about 1,500 kg, total 6,000 kg. 300 kg per color is fine.

rounds.ai_message: Good. About the color fastness — for reactive dye on cotton, we typically hit grade 4 on washing and grade 3-4 on rubbing. Does that meet your standard?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。色牢度方面,活性染料染棉,水洗牢度一般 4 级,摩擦牢度 3-4 级。达到你们标准吗?
rounds.common_mistakes: washing fastness(耐洗)和 rubbing fastness(耐摩擦) 是两个不同测试;行业说 grade 4-5 / 3-4 是 ISO 105 标准。
rounds.tips_zh: ISO 105 / AATCC 是色牢度测试标准,1-5 级,5 级最好。
rounds.user_response_example: Grade 4 washing and 3-4 rubbing meets our buyer's standard. We will do a final test on bulk production.

rounds.ai_message: OK. About handfeel — do you want a soft finish, a stiff finish, or normal? We can add a softener for the soft feel.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。手感方面,你们要柔软、硬挺还是常规?可以加柔软剂做软手感。
rounds.common_mistakes: handfeel / hand feel 都对,口语里常说 soft hand 或 soft handfeel。
rounds.tips_zh: 柔软剂(softener)分硅油(silicone)和非硅(non-silicone),硅油更滑但影响印花。
rounds.user_response_example: Soft hand is what we want. Please use a non-silicone softener — we will do printing on this fabric later, silicone can cause ink issues.

rounds.ai_message: Got it, non-silicone softener. About shrinkage — our standard is within 5% lengthwise and widthwise. We do pre-shrunk compacting, so it should be better. Is there anything else?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的,非硅柔软剂。缩水方面,我们标准是长度和宽度方向都在 5% 以内。做预缩紧式整理,会更好一点。还有别的吗?
rounds.common_mistakes: lengthwise / widthwise(L 方向 / W 方向) 缩水要分别报,不要笼统说 5%。
rounds.tips_zh: pre-shrunk(预缩)在染厂后整理阶段做,目的是减少后续水洗缩水。
rounds.user_response_example: 5% is acceptable, pre-shrunk is even better. Please send the lab dips by DHL when ready. Thanks, Wang.
